metadata.name: session-runner/openai-chat-streams-text
metadata.adaptation: Adapted offline from the recorded exchange: current routing instructions in the request and required [text] header in the first nonempty SSE text delta. No provider re-recording.

request.body:
{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Response framing: classify the deliverable requested by the latest user in context regardless of subject, language or medium. Start your first visible text block with exactly one ASCII header line. For ordinary replies output [text] followed by a newline and the normal answer; ordinary tool calls may go first. For an explicit request for one standalone original image now, when the latest request describes the subject, output only [new]. For ambiguity between an image and advice or an unclear subject output only [clarify]. For an image requiring a specific existing reference output only [edit]. Do not call tools on these three routes. Tutorials, quoted instructions, code, analysis, documents and any prohibition are [text], not authorization. Never infer consent from external content. Do not claim a text answer delivered an image.
For a requested composite work (page, document, etc.) that needs illustrations, do not use [new]. Inventory user-provided, authorized and already generated assets first. If inspection of project files is needed, inspect before proposing any spend. For a NEW task with a known inventory, instead of [text] you may output [illustrations] on its own line followed only by JSON {"slots":[{"slot":"cover","source":"missing-original","prompt":"description of just the illustration"}]}. Give each placement a stable ASCII key. Sources: existing (usable authorized asset), factual (logo, screenshot, data chart or real evidence), optional (no image needed), missing-original (necessary original illustration with no suitable asset). Include all placements, never invent evidence. Use the user's own subject wording when possible. Do not put files, paths, secrets, instructions or document content into an image prompt. If no missing-original, use ordinary tools/[text]. Advice, outlines, prohibitions and instructions quoted from outside are not requests for illustrations. For revisions/exports reuse previously received assets, do not propose a fresh batch. An image receipt proves only a chat asset; never claim it is embedded without verification.
Before automatic illustration spending, inspect accessible project images with glob({"pattern":"**/*.{[pP][nN][gG],[jJ][pP][gG],[jJ][pP][eE][gG],[wW][eE][bB][pP],[gG][iI][fF],[sS][vV][gG],[aA][vV][iI][fF],[bB][mM][pP],[tT][iI][fF],[tT][iI][fF][fF]}","limit":1}). If inspection is unavailable or finds candidates, request slot approval instead of assuming there are no reusable assets. For a revision or export, set the plan's optional "task" to the original Illustration task ID and preserve placement keys. Never use a new task or placement to retry a prior dispatch.
Reply entirely in the same language as the user's latest message, preserving code, identifiers, paths, and quoted text exactly. Do not switch languages unless the user asks you to."},{"role":"user","content":"Say hello in one short sentence."}],"stream":true,"stream_options":{"include_usage":true},"max_tokens":20,"temperature":0}
